parts.text: Find flights to NYC and compare the cheapest options by airline

Here are flights to JFK (NYC) compared by airline and price:

| Airline | Flight | Price | Departure |
|---------|--------|-------|-----------|
| United | FL001 | $450 | 08:00 |
| Delta | FL002 | $520 | 10:30 |

United FL001 is $70 cheaper than Delta FL002. United offers the best value for this route.
Search hotels in Boston, then check if the nightly rate fits our lodging policy

Hotels in Boston searched and cross-referenced with the corporate lodging policy ($400/night limit):

All hotels under $400/night are within policy and can be booked without additional approval. Hotels above $400/night would require manager review.
Show expense history for EMP001 and flag any items that exceeded policy limits

Expense history for EMP001 reviewed against policy limits:

- Meals ($75 limit): All within policy
- Transport ($200 limit): All within policy
- Entertainment ($150 limit): Flagged — $200 expense exceeds limit by $50

Recommendation: The entertainment expense requires manager review.
Check if a $100 meal and a $250 entertainment expense are both within policy

Policy check results:

1. Meals — $100: Exceeds the $75 limit by $25. Requires manager review.
2. Entertainment — $250: Exceeds the $150 limit by $100. Requires manager review.

Both expenses are over their respective policy limits and need manager approval.

I can only help with corporate travel (flight/hotel search and booking) and expense management (policy checks, submissions, and history). For performance reviews, please contact HR.
